$comment: Level-model exemptions: phases whose level is not APPLICABLE by construction, never phases that failed. An exemption must name a reason, an owner, the evidence that justifies it and what would close it; it may never be applied to a level that already has evidence (no hiding), and a phase still needs every other level evidenced plus at least three evidenced levels to derive COMPLETE. Each entry is revocable by the owner.

levelDefinitions.L2 data model: the phase owns or shapes persistent state (tables, migrations, typed registries)
levelDefinitions.L4 frontend/workspace integration: the phase's capability is projected by a workspace from real state

exemptions.reason: Phase 01 is a conventions phase: it owns verification, configuration, secret discipline and CI, and deliberately owns NO persistent state. Its data-plane obligation is migration DISCIPLINE (which it enforces) rather than tables of its own — the registries it validates belong to the phases that own them.
exemptions.closesWhen: Never by adding tables; revisit only if the level model gains an explicit 'conventions phase' class, at which point this exemption is deleted rather than carried.
exemptions.ratifiedBy: owner instruction 2026-09-14: close phases 01-03 to COMPLETE (the definitional gap is the model's, not the phase's)
